description:
[Merchant] **Replace** a campaign's details. An omitted startsOn, endsOn or externalRef is cleared; an omitted status keeps the current one. Get the campaign first and send every value you want to keep.

**Endpoint:** PUT /campaigns/{campaignId} (PRM plan)

campaignId.description: The campaign's ID: cp + 8 letters or digits, e.g. cp7e4rCToG

externalRef.description: An agency's own campaign code, up to 100 characters

status.description: Descriptive only: it does not switch the placements on or off

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_campaigns_update_campaign
